story.text: 남포동 이 골목, 우리 옛날에 맨날 왔던 데다.
story.reading: nam-po-dong i gol-mok, u-ri yen-nal-e maen-nal wat-deon de-da.
story.en: This alley in Nampo-dong, we used to come here all the time back then.

story.text: 이거 봐라, 어릴 때 우리 사진. 이 '추억'이 아직도 여 있더라.
story.reading: i-geo bwa-ra, eo-ril ttae u-ri sa-jin. i chu-eok-i a-jik-do yeo it-deo-ra.
story.en: Look at this, a picture of us as kids. This memory is still right here.

story.reading: i dong-ne o-ni-kka gap-ja-gi geu-rim-ne, geu-ttae-ga.
story.en: Coming to this neighborhood, I suddenly miss those days.

story.text: 근데 사진 속 니랑 지금 니랑 보니까... 좀 '낯설다', 이상하게. 이래 옆에 계속 있고 싶어질 정도로.
story.reading: geun-de sa-jin sok ni-rang ji-geum ni-rang bo-ni-kka... jom nat-seol-da, i-sang-ha-ge. i-rae yeop-e gye-sok it-go sip-eo-jil jeong-do-ro.
story.en: But comparing the you in the photo and the you now... it feels strangely unfamiliar. Unfamiliar enough that I want to keep you by my side like this.

story.text: '새삼' 니가 많이 컸구나 싶고... 아니, 그, 우리 친구잖아, 근데 아니 근데— 에엥, 내가 지금 뭔 말을 하고 있노.
story.reading: sae-sam ni-ga man-i keot-gu-na sip-go... a-ni, geu, u-ri chin-gu-jan-a, geun-de a-ni geun-de— e-eng, nae-ga ji-geum mwon mal-eul ha-go it-no.
story.en: I realize all over again how much you've grown up... I mean, we're friends, but— wait no— eh, what am I even saying right now.

story.text: 와 갑자기 말하다가 '어색해지노', 내가. 아이다! 아무 말도 안 했다, 방금! 자갈치나 가자, 배고프다!
story.reading: wa gap-ja-gi mal-ha-da-ga eo-saek-hae-ji-no, nae-ga. a-i-da! a-mu mal-do an haet-da, bang-geum! ja-gal-chi-na ga-ja, bae-go-peu-da!
story.en: Whoa, why am I suddenly getting awkward mid-sentence. No wait! I didn't say anything just now! Let's just go to Jagalchi, I'm hungry!

story.text: 단어는 다 봤제? 대화 문제도 있으니까 잘 읽어봐라.
story.reading: dan-eo-neun da bwat-je? dae-hwa mun-je-do it-eu-ni-kka jal ilg-eo-bwa-ra.
story.en: Got a look at all the words? There's a conversation question too, so read it carefully.

words.example_en: This photo is a precious memory.
There are times I miss my hometown.

words.example: 처음 간 도시는 모든 게 낯설었다.
words.example_reading: cheo-eum gan do-si-neun mo-deun ge nat-seol-eot-da
words.example_en: In the city I visited for the first time, everything felt unfamiliar.
I felt gratitude anew for his consideration.
Meeting after a long time, it was a bit awkward.

sentences.ko: 이 사진을 보니 어릴 적 추억이 떠올랐다.
sentences.reading: i sa-jin-eul bo-ni eo-ril jeok chu-eok-i tteo-ol-lat-da
sentences.en: Looking at this photo, memories from my childhood came to mind.
I sometimes miss my hometown friends.

sentences.ko: 오랜만에 만난 그가 왠지 낯설게 느껴졌다.
sentences.reading: o-raen-man-e man-nan geu-ga waen-ji nat-seol-ge neu-kkyeo-jyeot-da
sentences.en: Somehow, meeting him after so long felt unfamiliar.
I was struck anew by how much he had changed.
It suddenly got quiet and the mood became awkward.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: ...니랑 계속 이래 지낼 수 있으면 좋겠다. 그, 그니까 내 말은—
turns.reading: ...ni-rang gye-sok i-rae ji-nael su it-eu-myeon jo-ket-da. geu, geu-ni-kka nae mal-eun—
turns.en: ...I wish we could keep going on like this together. I mean, what I'm trying to say is—

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 어? 갑자기 뭔 말이고? 너 얼굴 왜 그래?
turns.reading: eo? gap-ja-gi mwon mal-i-go? neo eol-gul wae geu-rae?
turns.en: Huh? What's this sudden talk about? Why does your face look like that?

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 얼, 얼굴이 뭐! 아무렇지도 않다! …아니 잠깐만, 더워서 그렇다. 여름이잖아, 지금.
turns.reading: eol, eol-gul-i mwo! a-mu-reo-chi-do an-ta! …a-ni jam-kkan-man, deo-wo-seo geu-ro-ta. yeo-reum-i-jan-a, ji-geum.
turns.en: Wh-what's wrong with my face! I'm totally fine! …No wait, hold on, it's just hot out. It's summer right now.

dialogues.question: 선우가 갑자기 날씨 핑계를 댄 이유는 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: Why does Sunwoo suddenly make an excuse about the weather?
dialogues.correct_answer: 얼굴이 빨개진 진짜 이유를 숨기려고 급하게 둘러대서
options: 얼굴이 빨개진 진짜 이유를 숨기려고 급하게 둘러대서
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 진심이 튀어나올 뻔하자 당황해 얼굴이 빨개졌고, 그걸 감추려 앞뒤 안 맞는 날씨 핑계까지 댑니다.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: You were being serious just now, why are you suddenly changing the subject?

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 내가 언제? 안 그랬다! 자갈치 가서 씨앗호떡이나 무자, 어?
turns.reading: nae-ga eon-je? an geu-raet-da! ja-gal-chi ga-seo ssi-at-ho-tteok-i-na mu-ja, eo?
turns.en: When did I? I didn't do that! Let's just go to Jagalchi and eat some seed hotteok, okay?

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: So nonchalant. I saw your face just a second ago.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 봤어도 몬 본 척해도라, 쫌. 이런 거 진짜 부끄러버 죽겠다 내가.
turns.reading: bwa-sseo-do mon bon cheo-kae-do-ra, jjom. i-reon geo jin-jja bu-kkeu-reo-beo juk-get-da nae-ga.
turns.en: Even if you saw it, just pretend you didn't, seriously. This kind of thing seriously embarrasses me to death.

dialogues.question: 이 대화에서 선우의 태도로 알 수 있는 것은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What does Sunwoo's attitude in this conversation reveal?
dialogues.correct_answer: 진심이 들킬까 봐 장난과 딴소리로 급히 넘기려는 모습
options: 진심이 들킬까 봐 장난과 딴소리로 급히 넘기려는 모습
dialogues.explanation: 평소 장난스럽던 선우가 순간 진지해지며 속마음을 내비쳤다가, 들킨 걸 눈치채자 장난과 화제 전환으로 서둘러 얼버무리고 있습니다.
